title: conda OpenMM 8.6 + P100 (sm_60) = nvrtc failure
symptom: nvrtc: invalid value for --gpu-architecture at kernel start
root_cause: conda OpenMM 8.6 links cuda-nvrtc 13.3 which rejects sm_60/sm_70; Kaggle sessions get Tesla P100-PCIE-16GB (sm_60)
fix: pin openmm=8.3.1 (CUDA 12, libnvrtc.so.12) in the micromamba env; export CUDA_ARCH parsed from nvidia-smi --query-gpu=compute_cap before constructing the CUDA platform

title: --accelerator does not select the GPU
symptom: kernel-metadata accelerator='GPU T4 x2' but P100 still assigned
root_cause: GPU type/count/memory are platform-assigned by Kaggle; no kernel metadata override exists
fix: stop trying to force hardware; design around the assigned GPU (sm_60 path, TRAP-01)

title: RECELL: coordinates outside [0,box)^3 (PBC wrap)
symptom: NaN at step ~251; max|F| constant (~3.7e9 kJ/mol/nm) across steps 50-250; restraint force = 2*k*box on EVERY restrained C-alpha (v52: 2*4184*11.9097=99642)
root_cause: custom OPC solvator built the grid centroid-centered on the raw PDB frame and never re-centered the complex; CUDA wraps particle coords into [0,box)^3 while restraint refs stayed in the raw frame, so |x_wrapped - x_ref| = box for out-of-cell atoms
fix: shift = box/2 - center applied to protein+grid+ligand+ion logic inside solvate_opc, return shift, and apply the SAME shift when merging the ligand and writing positions back into modeller.positions; validate n_Pmin_outside_box drops 137036 -> ~0

title: bare /kaggle/input/<slug> mount 404s
symptom: FileNotFoundError / 'Bad input file' for dataset files
root_cause: Kaggle mounts datasets at /kaggle/input/datasets/<owner>/<slug>
fix: use the datasets/<owner>/<slug> convention or a find_input_dir() that tries both + walks /kaggle/input

title: dataset re-upload propagation lag
symptom: old mounts and 'Bad input file' errors persist minutes after kaggle datasets version
root_cause: registry-to-mount propagation is asynchronous
fix: poll/re-push; never 'fix' code that is actually correct

title: edits went to the file Kaggle does not execute
symptom: diagnostics added to code never appear in the kernel log
root_cause: Kaggle executes code_file from kernel-metadata.json (= run.py); run_md.py is only the supervisor's template
fix: edit run.py, keep identical: cp run.py run_md.py before every push

title: kaggle CLI missing in fresh sandbox
symptom: kaggle: command not found after sandbox reset
root_cause: pip installs do not persist across sessions; the key file does
fix: pip install -q kaggle each fresh session; keep the user-provided key file chmod 600

title: setParticleParameters/getParticleParameters API drift (8.3 vs 8.6)
symptom: ValueError: not enough values to unpack (expected 4, got 2)
root_cause: 8.3 getParticleParameters returns (idx, params) and setParticleParameters takes (i, idx, params); 8.6 differs
fix: rebuild the CustomExternalForce per stage (v53+ design) instead of mutating parameters

title: getState(getKineticEnergy=...) not in 8.3
symptom: TypeError: Context.getState() got an unexpected keyword argument 'getKineticEnergy'
root_cause: energy kwargs are 8.6-only
fix: getState(..., getEnergy=True) then .getKineticEnergy()/.getPotentialEnergy() on the returned State (v56 fix)

title: XmlSerializer.serialize stream arg not in 8.3
symptom: TypeError: XmlSerializer.serialize() takes 1 positional argument but 2 were given
root_cause: 8.3 serialize(obj) returns str with no stream parameter
fix: open(path,'w').write(XmlSerializer.serialize(obj)) (v54 fix)

title: stacked restraint forces across stages
symptom: restraints keep accumulating; FORCE MAP shows more than one restraint force per stage
root_cause: previous stage CustomExternalForce never removed
fix: system.removeForce(prev_fc_idx) before adding the next stage's force; at B5 remove entirely

title: restraint references taken from raw input coords
symptom: same 2*k*box signature as TRAP-03 even with re-centered positions
root_cause: restraint x0 refs must come from MINIMIZED coordinates (_Pmin), not raw input frames
fix: feed restraint refs from minimized_state positions

title: ligand rebuilt by re-embedding/alignment
symptom: bond/coordinate mismatch; forces ~65000 kJ/mol/nm from the ligand; garbage trajectories
root_cause: EmbedMolecule+AlignMol gave 1.56 Å RMSD and wrong H placement
fix: VF2 heavy-atom graph isomorphism (element-matched, bond-length validated 1.10-1.75 Å) then AddHs(addCoords=True); verify identity by InChIKey vs PubChem (MBZ: OPXLLQIJSORQAM-UHFFFAOYSA-N, CID 4030)

title: OPC O-M 0.0159 nm reported as a clash
symptom: clash report flags ('O',HOH)-('M',HOH) d=0.0159 nm
root_cause: 4-site OPC water keeps virtual site M on the bisector at 0.0159 nm inside the SAME residue
fix: exclude same-residue (and bonded) pairs in clash reports; this pair is healthy

title: DCD writer 'dt/AKMA' and 'firstStep' false-positive fixes
symptom: an external review suggests 'fixing' dt/AKMA or firstStep constants
root_cause: the hand-rolled SelDCD header (struct.pack '<i4c9if', 84, C,O,R,D; dt_ps/0.04888821) is byte-compatible with openmm/app/dcdfile.py
fix: do not change them; changing breaks CHARMM/OpenMM compatibility

title: chasing post-min |F|max ~3700 to zero
symptom: agent restarts/retunes because post-minimization max force stays ~3,700-3,950 kJ/mol/nm
root_cause: normal for 2000-iteration steep descent on ~187k particles (waters)
fix: proceed to equilibration; the B1-B5 ladder absorbs it

title: removing the per-session micromamba bootstrap
symptom: 'optimization' that skips env rebuild breaks on the next session
root_cause: Kaggle does not persist conda envs or /opt/conda between sessions
fix: keep the ~90s bootstrap; it is not the bottleneck

title: two supervisor loops running
symptom: double kernel launches, wasted GPU quota
root_cause: a second polling loop started after a sandbox reset without checking status
fix: after every reset check 'kaggle kernels status' first; start exactly one loop

title: PDBQT element-from-type-column parsing
symptom: wrong elements in the built ligand
root_cause: PDBQT atom-type column is unreliable for element inference
fix: use the docking SMILES graph (RDKit) as the chemical truth, coordinates from the pose (TRAP-13)

title: hammering the Kaggle API on 429
symptom: 429 Too Many Requests persists
root_cause: tight polling/push loop
fix: increase INTERVAL (e.g. 900->1800); the supervisor loop is backoff-tolerant

title: missing residue renames: CYS->CYX (11 disulfides) and chain terminal renames
symptom: forcefield templating/parameterization fails or silently produces a wrong system (v44-v46 NaN forensics all trace to terminal residues, e.g. first NaN = N NLYS B1)
root_cause: PDB residue names do not match the forcefield template: 11 SSB/SSA disulfides need CYX; chains need N/C terminal variants (terminals: B: NLYS..CCYX; A: NGLY..CVAL; Z: CA..CA)
fix: rename CYS->CYX for the 11 disulfides and apply per-chain terminal renames BEFORE ForceField/SystemGenerator parameterization; audit the first-minimized-NaN atom name against the rename map
evidence: runbook refs §5 prep step 5; NaN forensics v44/v45/v46
